ufw allow in proto tcp to any port 22 comment 'darkpanel:01J00000000000000000000000 ssh'
ufw deny in proto udp from 2001:db8::/32 to any port 5000:5100
ufw route allow out on eth0 proto tcp to 172.17.0.2 port 80
ufw limit in proto tcp to any port 2222
ufw reject in to any port 3000
ufw allow in log proto tcp from 10.0.0.0/8 to any port 443,8000:8100
ufw allow out on eth0 to any port 53
ufw allow in on eth0 proto esp
ufw --force enable
printf '[DP Web]\ntitle=Darkpanel test\ndescription=Darkpanel test profile\nports=8443,9443/tcp\n' > /etc/ufw/applications.d/dp-test
ufw allow 'DP Web'
ufw deny from 2001:db8::1/32
ufw allow 8080/tcp comment 'hand rule'
